title: Postal Service Mail Carriers
description: Sort and deliver mail for the United States Postal Service (USPS). Deliver mail on established route by vehicle or on foot. Includes postal service mail carriers employed by USPS contractors.

tasks.text: Scan labels on letters or parcels to confirm receipt.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Data entry into systems automatable

dwas.name: Enter information into databases or software programs.

tasks.text: Obtain signed receipts for registered, certified, and insured mail, collect associated charges, and complete any necessary paperwork.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Drafting aided; authorized signature human

dwas.name: Obtain written authorization to perform activities.

tasks.text: Return to the post office with mail collected from homes, businesses, and public mailboxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Sort mail for delivery, arranging it in delivery sequence.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sorting physical mail requires hands-on handling

tasks.text: Deliver mail to residences and business establishments along specified routes by walking or driving, using a combination of satchels, carts, cars, and small trucks.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Meet schedules for the collection and return of mail.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Sign for cash-on-delivery and registered mail before leaving the post office.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Broad clerical tasks partly automatable, human oversees exceptions

tasks.text: Hold mail for customers who are away from delivery locations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Turn in money and receipts collected along mail routes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Handling cash/payment collection in person

tasks.text: Leave notices telling patrons where to collect mail that could not be delivered.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Maintain accurate records of deliveries.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record shipping information into structured fields

tasks.text: Bundle mail in preparation for delivery or transportation to relay boxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual packing for shipping

tasks.text: Record address changes and redirect mail for those addresses.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Return incorrectly addressed mail to senders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Routing physical mail requires sorting by hand

tasks.text: Answer customers' questions about postal services and regulations.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Provide customers with change of address cards and other forms.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Report any unusual circumstances concerning mail delivery, including the condition of street letter boxes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reporting maintenance problems is routine messaging

dwas.name: Report maintenance or equipment problems to appropriate personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Register, certify, and insure parcels and letters.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Coverage arranged via systems; judgment and liability human

tasks.text: Travel to post offices to pick up the mail for routes or pick up mail from postal relay boxes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Sell stamps and money orders.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Closing sales requires persuasion and accountability

tasks.text: Complete forms that notify publishers of address changes.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Compliance docs drafted; human owns regulatory accuracy

dwas.name: Prepare documentation for contracts, transactions, or regulatory compliance.
